name: Netchex - Mesh AI Teammates
description:
Netchex - Mesh AI Teammates brings your company's HR knowledge into Claude. Ask everyday HR questions in plain language, about the employee handbook, paid holidays, PTO and leave policies, benefits and plan summaries, onboarding, and other documents your HR team has uploaded, and get answers drawn directly from your company's own materials, with citations to the source documents.

Answers are automatically scoped to the signed-in employee's company, so each user only sees information relevant to their organization. You sign in with your existing Netchex account through secure single sign-on. The connector never sees your password, and Claude never receives your Netchex credentials.

Typical questions:
• "How many vacation days do I accrue per year?"
• "What's our policy on remote work?"
• "When is the next company holiday?"
• "What does my health plan cover for dental?"

Netchex - Mesh AI Teammates is read-only. It retrieves answers from your HR documents and does not change any HR data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Netchex - Mesh AI Teammates to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Netchex - Mesh AI Teammates to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.netchexonline.net/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.
